column2:
gallery(n.)畫廊、美術館、走廊
(無詞性變化)
art gallery 美術館、畫廊
photo gallery 相簿、攝影展覽
We spent the whole afternoon at the art gallery downtown.
(我們在市中心的美術館待了一整個下午。)
Her paintings are on display in a small gallery.
(她的畫作正在一間小畫廊展出。)

gaze(n./v.)凝視、注視
(無詞性變化)
gaze at 凝視著…
a steady gaze 目不轉睛的凝視
She sat by the window, gazing at the stars.
(她坐在窗邊，凝視著星星。)
He could not meet his father's angry gaze.
(他不敢正視父親憤怒的眼神。)

gear(n./v.)排檔、齒輪、裝備、使適合
(無詞性變化)
camping gear 露營裝備
change gear 換檔
Remember to bring your camping gear this weekend.
(這個週末記得帶你的露營裝備。)
The program is geared toward beginners.
(這個課程是為初學者設計的。)

gender(n.)性別
(無詞性變化)
gender equality 性別平等
gender roles 性別角色
Our school holds lectures on gender equality every year.
(我們學校每年都舉辦性別平等講座。)
Jobs should not be limited by gender.
(工作不應該受到性別限制。)

gene(n.)基因
genetic(adj.)基因的、遺傳的
genetics(n.)遺傳學
gene therapy 基因療法
carry a gene 帶有某基因
Eye color is decided by our genes.
(眼睛的顏色是由我們的基因決定的。)
Scientists found a gene linked to the disease.
(科學家發現了一個和這種疾病有關的基因。)

generation(n.)世代、一代人、產生
generate(v.)產生
generation gap 代溝
future generations 後代子孫
There is a big generation gap between my grandpa and me.
(我和我爺爺之間有很大的代溝。)
We must protect the earth for future generations.
(我們必須為了後代子孫保護地球。)

generosity(n.)慷慨、大方
generous(adj.)慷慨的
generously(adv.)慷慨地
thanks to one's generosity 多虧某人的慷慨
show generosity 表現慷慨
We thanked him for his generosity and kindness.
(我們感謝他的慷慨與善良。)
Thanks to her generosity, the poor children got new books.
(多虧她的慷慨，貧困的孩子們拿到了新書。)

genius(n.)天才、天賦
(無詞性變化)
a musical genius 音樂天才
a genius at/for 在…方面的天才
Mozart was a musical genius.
(莫札特是個音樂天才。)
My cousin is a genius at solving math problems.
(我表哥解數學題是個天才。)

genuine(adj.)真正的、真誠的
genuinely(adv.)真誠地
genuine leather 真皮
genuine interest 真正的興趣
This bag is made of genuine leather.
(這個包包是真皮做的。)
She showed a genuine interest in helping others.
(她對幫助別人展現出真誠的熱忱。)

germ(n.)病菌、細菌、萌芽
(無詞性變化)
spread germs 傳播病菌
kill germs 殺菌
Washing your hands can stop germs from spreading.
(洗手可以防止病菌傳播。)
Cover your mouth when you cough to avoid spreading germs.
(咳嗽時要遮住嘴巴，避免傳播病菌。)

gifted(adj.)有天賦的、天資聰穎的
gift(n.)禮物、天賦
gifted students 資優生
gifted in/at 在…方面有天賦
She is gifted at playing the piano.
(她在彈鋼琴方面很有天賦。)
The school has a special class for gifted students.
(這所學校為資優生開設了特別班。)

gigantic(adj.)巨大的、龐大的
giant(n.)巨人
a gigantic wave 巨浪
gigantic size 龐大的體型
A gigantic wave hit the small fishing boat.
(一道巨浪打中了那艘小漁船。)
The new shopping mall is gigantic.
(那間新購物中心大得驚人。)

giggle(n./v.)咯咯地笑、傻笑
(無詞性變化)
giggle at 對…咯咯笑
get the giggles 笑個不停
The girls giggled at the funny picture.
(女孩們看著那張好笑的圖片咯咯地笑。)
We couldn't stop giggling during the quiet class.
(在安靜的課堂上我們忍不住一直偷笑。)

ginger(n.)薑
(無詞性變化)
ginger tea 薑茶
fresh ginger 生薑
My mom makes ginger tea when I catch a cold.
(我感冒時媽媽會煮薑茶給我喝。)
Add some fresh ginger to the soup.
(在湯裡加一點生薑。)

glimpse(n./v.)瞥見、一瞥
(無詞性變化)
catch a glimpse of 瞥見…
a glimpse into 對…的初步了解
I caught a glimpse of the singer as she left.
(那位歌手離開時我瞥見了她一眼。)
The museum gives us a glimpse into ancient life.
(這間博物館讓我們一窺古代的生活。)

globe(n.)地球、地球儀、球體
global(adj.)全球的
around the globe 全世界
a model globe 地球儀
People around the globe watched the World Cup final.
(全世界的人都觀看了世界盃決賽。)
The teacher pointed to Taiwan on the globe.
(老師在地球儀上指出台灣的位置。)

glorious(adj.)光榮的、輝煌的、極好的
glory(n.)榮耀
glorious history 輝煌的歷史
glorious weather 極好的天氣
The city has a long and glorious history.
(這座城市有悠久而輝煌的歷史。)
We enjoyed a glorious sunny day at the beach.
(我們在海邊度過了陽光燦爛的美好一天。)

goods(n.)商品、貨物
(無詞性變化)
consumer goods 消費品
sporting goods 運動用品
The store sells sporting goods at low prices.
(這家店以低價販賣運動用品。)
The goods will be delivered within three days.
(這些貨物將在三天內送達。)

gown(n.)禮服、長袍
(無詞性變化)
evening gown 晚禮服
graduation gown 畢業袍
The actress wore a beautiful evening gown.
(那位女演員穿了一件美麗的晚禮服。)
Students wear graduation gowns at the ceremony.
(學生們在典禮上穿著畢業袍。)

grace(n./v.)優雅、風度、增光
graceful(adj.)優雅的
gracious(adj.)親切的、有禮的
with grace 優雅地、得體地
saving grace 唯一可取之處
The dancer moved across the stage with grace.
(那位舞者優雅地舞過舞台。)
He accepted the loss with grace.
(他很有風度地接受了失敗。)

graceful(adj.)優雅的、得體的
grace(n.)優雅
gracefully(adv.)優雅地
graceful movement 優雅的動作
a graceful exit 得體的退場
The swan looked graceful on the lake.
(湖上的天鵝看起來很優雅。)
She is famous for her graceful dancing.
(她以優雅的舞姿聞名。)

gracious(adj.)親切的、有禮的、優雅的
grace(n.)優雅、風度
graciously(adv.)親切地、有禮地
a gracious host 親切的主人
gracious living 優雅的生活
Our gracious host made us feel at home.
(親切的主人讓我們感到賓至如歸。)
She gave a gracious smile to everyone.
(她向大家露出親切的微笑。)

graduation(n.)畢業、畢業典禮
graduate(v./n.)畢業、畢業生
graduation ceremony 畢業典禮
after graduation 畢業後
My parents came to my graduation ceremony.
(我爸媽來參加了我的畢業典禮。)
What are your plans after graduation?
(你畢業後有什麼計畫？)

grammar(n.)文法
grammatical(adj.)文法的
grammar mistake 文法錯誤
English grammar 英文文法
Please check your essay for grammar mistakes.
(請檢查你的作文有沒有文法錯誤。)
Learning grammar helps you write better sentences.
(學文法能幫助你寫出更好的句子。)

grammatical(adj.)文法上的、合乎文法的
grammar(n.)文法
grammatically(adv.)文法上
grammatical error 文法錯誤
grammatical structure 文法結構
This sentence is short but grammatical.
(這個句子雖然短但合乎文法。)
The teacher corrected the grammatical errors in my essay.
(老師訂正了我作文裡的文法錯誤。)

graph(n./v.)圖表、用圖表示
graphic(adj.)圖像的、生動的
bar graph 長條圖
line graph 折線圖
The bar graph shows the students' test scores.
(這張長條圖顯示學生的考試成績。)
We used a line graph to show the temperature changes.
(我們用折線圖來表示溫度的變化。)

grateful(adj.)感激的
gratitude(n.)感激
be grateful to sb. 感激某人
be grateful for sth. 感激某事
I am grateful to my teacher for her help.
(我很感激老師的幫忙。)
We should be grateful for what we have.
(我們應該對自己擁有的心存感激。)

gratitude(n.)感激、感謝
grateful(adj.)感激的
express gratitude 表達感謝
a sense of gratitude 感恩的心
I wrote a card to express my gratitude.
(我寫了一張卡片來表達我的感謝。)
She smiled at him with gratitude.
(她感激地對他微笑。)

grave(n./adj.)墳墓、嚴重的、嚴肅的
gravely(adv.)嚴重地
visit a grave 掃墓
grave danger 嚴重的危險
We visit our ancestors' graves on Tomb Sweeping Day.
(我們在清明節去祭掃祖先的墳墓。)
Climate change puts many animals in grave danger.
(氣候變遷讓許多動物陷入嚴重的危險。)

greasy(adj.)油膩的
grease(n.)油脂
greasy food 油膩的食物
greasy hair 油膩的頭髮
Eating too much greasy food is bad for your health.
(吃太多油膩的食物對健康不好。)
The plates were greasy after the barbecue.
(烤肉後盤子都油油的。)

greeting(n.)問候、招呼
greetings(n.)問候語、祝賀
greet(v.)問候、迎接
greeting card 賀卡
exchange greetings 互相問候
I sent my grandma a birthday greeting card.
(我寄了一張生日賀卡給奶奶。)
The two old friends exchanged warm greetings.
(兩位老朋友熱情地互相問候。)

grief(n.)悲傷、悲痛
grieve(v.)悲傷
overcome with grief 悲痛欲絕
deep grief 深切的悲痛
She was overcome with grief when her dog died.
(她的狗死去時，她悲痛欲絕。)
Time can slowly heal our grief.
(時間能慢慢撫平我們的悲傷。)

grind(v./n.)磨碎、研磨、苦差事
ground(v.)磨碎(過去式、過去分詞)
grinder(n.)研磨機
grind coffee beans 磨咖啡豆
the daily grind 日常的苦差事
My father grinds coffee beans every morning.
(我爸爸每天早上都磨咖啡豆。)
Studying for exams every day can feel like a grind.
(每天為考試讀書可能讓人覺得很辛苦。)

guarantee(v./n.)保證、擔保、保固
(無詞性變化)
money-back guarantee 退款保證
under guarantee 在保固期內
Hard work does not always guarantee success.
(努力不一定能保證成功。)
The laptop comes with a two-year guarantee.
(這台筆電附有兩年保固。)

guardian(n.)監護人、守護者
guard(v./n.)守衛
legal guardian 法定監護人
guardian angel 守護天使
Students need a parent or guardian to sign the form.
(學生需要家長或監護人在表格上簽名。)
The old tree is seen as the guardian of the village.
(那棵老樹被視為村子的守護者。)

guilt(n.)內疚、罪惡感、有罪
guilty(adj.)內疚的、有罪的
feel guilt 感到內疚
a sense of guilt 罪惡感
He felt a strong sense of guilt for lying to his mom.
(他對媽媽說謊感到強烈的罪惡感。)
The court found no proof of his guilt.
(法院找不到他有罪的證據。)

guilty(adj.)內疚的、有罪的
guilt(n.)內疚、罪行
feel guilty about 對…感到內疚
be found guilty 被判有罪
I feel guilty about forgetting my best friend's birthday.
(我對忘記好友的生日感到內疚。)
The man was found guilty of stealing.
(那名男子被判竊盜罪成立。)

gulf(n.)海灣、鴻溝
(無詞性變化)
the Gulf of Mexico 墨西哥灣
a gulf between 兩者之間的鴻溝
The oil spill polluted the Gulf of Mexico.
(石油外洩汙染了墨西哥灣。)
There is a wide gulf between the rich and the poor.
(貧富之間存在著巨大的鴻溝。)

habitual(adj.)習慣性的、慣常的
habit(n.)習慣
habitually(adv.)習慣性地
a habitual liar 慣性說謊者
habitual behavior 習慣性行為
Nobody believes a habitual liar.
(沒有人會相信一個習慣說謊的人。)
His habitual lateness made his boss angry.
(他習慣性遲到讓老闆很生氣。)

halt(n./v.)停止、中止
(無詞性變化)
come to a halt 停下來
bring to a halt 使停止
The bus came to a sudden halt in the middle of the road.
(公車在路中間突然停了下來。)
The heavy rain halted the baseball game.
(大雨使棒球比賽中止。)

handwriting(n.)筆跡、手寫
(無詞性變化)
neat handwriting 工整的字跡
messy handwriting 潦草的字跡
Her neat handwriting is easy to read.
(她工整的字跡很容易閱讀。)
I can't read the doctor's messy handwriting.
(我看不懂醫生潦草的字跡。)

hardship(n.)艱難、困苦
(無詞性變化)
face hardship 面對困境
financial hardship 經濟困難
The family faced many hardships after the war.
(戰後這家人面臨了許多困苦。)
He never gave up, even in times of hardship.
(即使在艱困的時候，他也從不放棄。)

hardware(n.)硬體、五金器具
software(n.)軟體
computer hardware 電腦硬體
hardware store 五金行
My uncle sells computer hardware and software.
(我叔叔販售電腦硬體與軟體。)
We bought some nails at the hardware store.
(我們在五金行買了一些釘子。)

harmony(n.)和諧、融洽、和聲
harmonious(adj.)和諧的
in harmony with 與…和諧
live in harmony 和睦相處
People should live in harmony with nature.
(人們應該與大自然和諧共處。)
The choir sang in perfect harmony.
(合唱團唱出完美的和聲。)

harsh(adj.)嚴厲的、嚴酷的、刺耳的
harshly(adv.)嚴厲地
harsh words 嚴厲的話
harsh weather 嚴酷的天氣
The coach's harsh words made him cry.
(教練嚴厲的話讓他哭了出來。)
Few plants can survive in such harsh weather.
(很少植物能在這麼嚴酷的天氣中存活。)

haste(n.)匆忙、急忙
hasty(adj.)倉促的
hasten(v.)加速、催促
in haste 匆忙地
Haste makes waste. 欲速則不達。
She left the house in haste and forgot her keys.
(她匆忙出門，忘了帶鑰匙。)
Take your time. Haste makes waste.
(慢慢來，欲速則不達。)

hasten(v.)加速、催促、趕緊
haste(n.)匆忙
hasty(adj.)倉促的
hasten the process 加快過程
hasten to add 趕緊補充
Warm weather can hasten the growth of plants.
(溫暖的天氣能加速植物生長。)
I hasten to add that it was not his fault.
(我得趕緊補充一點，那不是他的錯。)

hatred(n.)憎恨、仇恨
hate(v.)恨、討厭
full of hatred 充滿仇恨
hatred toward/of 對…的仇恨
His heart was full of hatred after the war.
(戰爭過後他的心中充滿了仇恨。)
Love is stronger than hatred.
(愛比恨更強大。)

hawk(n.)鷹、主戰派
(無詞性變化)
eyes like a hawk 眼光銳利
watch like a hawk 嚴密監視
A hawk flew over the field looking for food.
(一隻老鷹飛過田野尋找食物。)
Our teacher watches us like a hawk during exams.
(考試時老師像老鷹一樣緊盯著我們。)

helicopter(n.)直升機
(無詞性變化)
rescue helicopter 救援直升機
by helicopter 搭直升機
The injured climber was taken to the hospital by helicopter.
(受傷的登山客被直升機送往醫院。)
A rescue helicopter flew over the flooded village.
(一架救援直升機飛過淹水的村莊。)

herd(n./v.)獸群、牧群、放牧、聚集
herder(n.)牧人
a herd of cattle 一群牛
herd mentality 從眾心理
A herd of cattle was eating grass on the hill.
(一群牛正在山坡上吃草。)
The teacher herded the children onto the bus.
(老師把孩子們趕上了遊覽車。)

hesitation(n.)猶豫、躊躇
hesitate(v.)猶豫
without hesitation 毫不猶豫
a moment's hesitation 片刻的猶豫
He jumped into the river without hesitation to save the boy.
(他毫不猶豫地跳進河裡救那個男孩。)
After a moment's hesitation, she said yes.
(猶豫片刻之後，她答應了。)

hive(n.)蜂巢、蜂箱、熱鬧繁忙的地方
(無詞性變化)
beehive 蜂窩、蜂巢
a hive of activity 一片忙碌的景象
Thousands of bees live in a single hive.
(一個蜂巢裡住著數千隻蜜蜂。)
The kitchen was a hive of activity before the party.
(派對開始前，廚房裡一片忙碌。)

homeland(n.)祖國、家鄉
(無詞性變化)
return to one's homeland 回到家鄉
defend one's homeland 保衛家園
After many years abroad, he returned to his homeland.
(在國外多年後，他回到了家鄉。)
The soldiers fought bravely to defend their homeland.
(士兵們英勇作戰保衛家園。)

honeymoon(n./v.)蜜月、度蜜月
(無詞性變化)
go on a honeymoon 去度蜜月
honeymoon period 蜜月期
The couple went to Bali on their honeymoon.
(這對夫妻去峇里島度蜜月。)
The honeymoon period of the new president is over.
(新總統的蜜月期已經結束了。)

hook(n./v.)鉤子、掛鉤、鉤住、使著迷
hooked(adj.)著迷的、上癮的
off the hook 脫離困境
be hooked on 對…著迷
He hung his coat on the hook behind the door.
(他把外套掛在門後的掛鉤上。)
My little sister is hooked on that cartoon.
(我妹妹迷上了那部卡通。)

horizon(n.)地平線、眼界
horizontal(adj.)水平的
on the horizon 在地平線上、即將發生
broaden one's horizons 拓展視野
The sun slowly sank below the horizon.
(太陽緩緩落到地平線下。)
Traveling abroad can broaden your horizons.
(出國旅行能拓展你的視野。)

horrify(v.)使驚嚇、使震驚
horrified(adj.)驚恐的
horror(n.)恐怖
be horrified at/by 對…感到震驚
horrifying news 駭人的消息
We were horrified by the news of the accident.
(這起意外的消息讓我們大為震驚。)
The violent scenes in the movie horrified the audience.
(電影中的暴力場面嚇壞了觀眾。)

hose(n./v.)水管、用水管沖洗
(無詞性變化)
garden hose 澆花水管
hose down 用水管沖洗
Dad used a garden hose to water the plants.
(爸爸用水管幫植物澆水。)
We hosed down the car after the trip.
(旅行回來後我們用水管把車沖洗乾淨。)

household(n.)家庭、一家人
(無詞性變化)
household chores 家事
household name 家喻戶曉的人物
Every member of the household should help with household chores.
(家中每個成員都應該幫忙做家事。)
The singer became a household name in Taiwan.
(那位歌手在台灣家喻戶曉。)

housework(n.)家事
(無詞性變化)
do housework 做家事
share the housework 分擔家事
My brother and I share the housework every weekend.
(我和哥哥每個週末分擔家事。)
Doing housework can be good exercise.
(做家事也可以是不錯的運動。)

humanity(n.)人類、人性、人道
human(adj./n.)人類的、人
humanities(n.)人文學科
crimes against humanity 違反人道罪
the future of humanity 人類的未來
Climate change is a serious threat to humanity.
(氣候變遷對人類是一大威脅。)
Helping strangers shows our humanity.
(幫助陌生人展現了我們的人性。)

humidity(n.)濕度、潮濕
humid(adj.)潮濕的
high humidity 高濕度
humidity level 濕度
The high humidity in Taiwan makes summer feel hotter.
(台灣的高濕度讓夏天感覺更熱。)
Use a machine to control the humidity in your room.
(用機器來控制房間的濕度。)

hurricane(n.)颶風
(無詞性變化)
hurricane season 颶風季
be hit by a hurricane 遭颶風侵襲
Many homes were destroyed when the hurricane hit Florida.
(颶風侵襲佛州時，許多房屋被摧毀。)
People stocked up on food before the hurricane season.
(人們在颶風季來臨前囤積食物。)

hush(n./v.)寂靜、使安靜
(無詞性變化)
a sudden hush 突然的寂靜
hush up 掩蓋、隱瞞
A hush fell over the room when the principal walked in.
(校長走進來時，房間裡突然一片寂靜。)
The mother hushed her crying baby.
(那位媽媽哄她哭鬧的寶寶安靜下來。)

hydrogen(n.)氫
(無詞性變化)
hydrogen gas 氫氣
hydrogen bomb 氫彈
Water is made up of hydrogen and oxygen.
(水是由氫和氧組成的。)
Some new cars run on hydrogen instead of gasoline.
(有些新型汽車使用氫而非汽油作為燃料。)
